use: Club news and team-status briefing page panorama
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a production-ready panoramic header illustration for a football club management game's combined Club News and Team Briefing page.
Primary request: a welcoming football club briefing room where the owner can understand the current team's situation and read the club's latest news, told through a cohesive environmental scene, not an interface mockup.
Scene and subject: a small European football club's well-kept operations room at dusk. A broad wooden briefing table in the foreground holds an open cream report folder, a few neatly layered team reports with tiny abstract chart marks, a folded club newspaper, a pencil and a warm brass desk lamp. Behind it a substantial dark-green tactics and briefing board shows a simple football pitch with small round squad markers and a few restrained chalk routes. Beside it a cork news board holds a small set of pinned cream notices and football photo clippings. A window reveals part of the club's green pitch, low stadium terraces and the soft evening sky. Modest shelving and green visitor chairs complete the room. It feels ready for the owner's daily club briefing, not a press conference.
Style and medium: refined handcrafted 2D pixel art for a premium football management game. Dense, carefully placed small square pixels on a coherent grid, approximately a 480 by 160 logical pixel scene enlarged cleanly. Finer and more closely packed pixels than coarse retro icons. Crisp stepped contours, controlled pixel clusters, subtle selective dithering and beautiful small environmental details; do not use big chunky blocks, blur, smooth vector outlines, painterly strokes or photographic textures.
Composition and framing: one continuous wide panoramic illustration, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, composed for a shallow page hero. Eye-level with a slightly elevated view of the report table. Table, board, notices and pitch window remain readable together in the central horizontal band. Strong clear silhouette and breathing room; attractive at desktop width and when reduced to mobile width. Edge-to-edge scene, not an isolated object or a diorama on a blank background.
Palette and lighting: the existing game's charcoal, muted forest green, dark walnut and warm ivory palette, with amber lamplight and a little cool blue dusk from the window. Calm, attentive, grounded and quietly optimistic; maintain readable detail without crushing shadows.
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numerals, no invented logos, no watermarks, no UI panels, no buttons, no baked-in page title, no borders. Reports and notices use only small abstract marks; all actual game news, figures and headings will be rendered separately as live HTML. No people. Deliver only the finished illustration.
